inclusion_rule: Include studies that generate speech (waveform or vocoder features) from a non-acoustic speech signal (ultrasound, EMA, PMA, EMG, lip or face video, rtMRI, intracranial or scalp neural recordings) and in which F0 or voicing of the output is predicted or evaluated. Boundary: exclude acoustic-input conversion (whisper, electrolarynx or NAM as the only input), talking-head or head-motion synthesis driven by speech, text-to-speech after text decoding, and reviews; the pattern match is an upper bound; versions count once by key.
